verdict.rationale: RudderStack's API docs list a dedicated HTTP API to 'Send event data from source to connected destinations', plus a Pixel API for GET-based tracking, so a documented HTTP ingestion path exists for server-to-server sending. Nothing in the pack describes how requests are authenticated or what delivery guarantees apply (retries, at-least-once, durability). missing for 10: documented authentication scheme for the ingestion API, documented delivery guarantees/retry semantics, endpoint-level reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of server-to-server ingestion.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees
